summary: An official answers a donor question by saying contributions never decided a vote.
realLife: A California councilmember told a reporter that votes are never based on contributions.
sources: Yahoo News, California lawmakers enacted a bill to limit local pay-to-play politics: https://ca.news.yahoo.com/california-lawmakers-enacted-bill-limit-120000932.html
inGame: donor-ask reply moves (decline, disagree) and the vote record the player can point to

turns.turn: The record shows a gift then a yes
turns.pull: the vote and the gift on the same bill

turns.turn: The official has refused a donor before
